messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy of service-inference v3.7.2 to staging finished. Post-deploy env-parity-check: FAILED — /secrets/redis_url encoding mismatch.

alex: saw the alert, any idea what changed with KMS or secret encoding?

maria: I rotated the staging KMS key yesterday as part of scheduled rotation. Alias: `alias/redwood/staging/kv` (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/staging-key).

ankit: prod still uses `alias/redwood/production/kv` (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/prod-key). Different keys => ciphertext mismatch. Secrets loader expects prod alias on promotion.

maria: oh right, I forgot to update the staging flag that allows fallback aliases. sorry everyone :grimacing: 

deploy-bot: env-parity-diff (automated):
```
- /secrets/redis_url (staging): ciphertext v2, key arn:aws:kms:...:staging-key
- /secrets/redis_url (prod): ciphertext v1, key arn:aws:kms:...:prod-key
```

sre-oncall: critical: if we promote v3.7.2 to prod as-is, many services will fail to decrypt config. Recommend HOLD prod rollout. :warning:

alex: +1. @jamie-pm can you pin the release and stop the scheduled prod deploy?

jamie-pm: holding prod rollout now. Marking release as `canary-only` and notifying impacted teams.

release-manager: short mitigation options:
- revert staging KMS alias (risky, undoes rotation)
- change secrets-loader to accept both aliases (backwards compatible)
- pin prod to v3.7.1 and block v3.7.2 until fix

ankit: prefer updating secrets-loader + add KMS_ALIASES fallback list. low blast radius. I'll open a PR.

maria: I'll run a one-off staging deploy after PR to validate decrypts.

sre-oncall: ops step: pin prod image to previous version until fix is validated. Command: 
```
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/service-inference service-inference=redwood/service-inference:v3.7.1
```

release-manager: done — prod image pinned, automated rollout blocked (CI flag `allow_prod_release=false`). Notifying security & support.

maria: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321 to add `KMS_ALIASES` and updated runbook. Will trigger staging deploy after CI.

ankit: PR LGTM, added unit test decrypt_with_aliases. Merging after green.

deploy-bot: Post-merge staged deploy ran, secrets-loader now accepts both aliases, decrypt validated for /secrets/*, smoke tests passed.

jamie-pm: thanks. Action items: ankit/maria — add retro note and update KMS rotation runbook; release-manager — keep prod pinned until next coordinated change window; support — notify customers about the hold.

alex: TL;DR — hold prod, pin to v3.7.1, patch staging to accept aliases, validate, schedule promotion next change window. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: will close incident after successful prod promotion and canary checks show no decrypt errors.
